# Cross-Encoder Graph Re-Ranking and Terminal Path Validation

> Stage-2 cross-encoder scoring of multi-hop paths and terminal validation gates to eliminate non-deductive associative drift in RAG.

## Core Findings

- Cross-encoder re-ranking models (e.g. BGE-Reranker, Cohere Rerank) applied to serialized multi-hop graph candidate paths improve NDCG@10 by 12–18% over bi-encoder similarity rankings by capturing full inter-token cross-attention. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.07597]
- Terminal path validation filters spurious graph paths that share surface entities but lack causal or deductive connection to the user prompt, reducing downstream LLM hallucination rates by > 30%. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.03267]
- Applying cross-encoders as a stage-2 reranker over top-50 graph candidate subgraphs balances inference latency (15–30ms per query on GPU/Apple Silicon) with maximum precision gains. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.07597]
